datasets.name: ODS_girov
datasets.sql:
select*from (
select p.id,p.boorowerid,p.numberofcredit,(select name from filial where id =p.branchid ) filial,p.creditlineamount,
case when p.partitionkey=0 then  'Açıq'else 'Bağlı' end status,
(select description from cm_pledges where id=g.pledgeid)pledgeid,
(select name  from cm_pledgsorts where id=g.pledgsorts)pledgsorts,
g.pledgename,g.holdername,g.registryagency,g.registryno,g.registrydate,g.pledgeprice,g.outcollateralaccid,ac.likvid_acc_no,ac.likvid_rest,
ac.likvid_rest*t.ostat  Eklikvid ,
 g.gqname,g.gqpaspnum,g.gqpaspdate,g.gqadress,g.gqtelmob,g.reyster,g.companydat,r.description,
 (select val_name from avalute_t where valute =g.currency)val_acc,p.tmnus_status,p.tmnus_portfstatus
from 
 cm_portfolio p
,cm_guarantee_credit g
,cm_guaranteeaccounts ac
,temprate t
,cm_reserve_types r,cm_curr_state h
 where p.id=g.creditid(+)  
 and  t.val_kod=p.currency 
 and p.id=h.creditid
 and h.reserveid=r.id
 and  ac.creditid=g.creditid
 and  g.cardid=1 and ac.cardid=1


union all
select p.id,p.boorowerid,p.numberofcredit,(select name from filial where id =p.branchid ) filial,p.creditlineamount,
case when p.partitionkey=0 then  'Açıq'else 'Bağlı' end status,
(select description from cm_pledges where id=g.pledgeid)pledgeid,
(select name  from cm_pledgsorts where id=g.pledgsorts)pledgsorts,
g.pledgename,g.holdername,g.registryagency,g.registryno,g.registrydate,g.pledgeprice,g.outcollateralaccid,ac.likvid_acc_no,ac.likvid_rest,
ac.likvid_rest*t.ostat  Eklikvid ,
 g.gqname,g.gqpaspnum,g.gqpaspdate,g.gqadress,g.gqtelmob,g.reyster,g.companydat,r.description,
 (select val_name from avalute_t where valute =g.currency)val_acc,p.tmnus_status,p.tmnus_portfstatus
from 
 cm_portfolio p
,cm_guarantee_credit g
,cm_guaranteeaccounts ac
,temprate t
,cm_reserve_types r,cm_curr_state h
 where p.id=g.creditid(+)  
 and  t.val_kod=p.currency 
 and p.id=h.creditid
 and h.reserveid=r.id
 and  ac.creditid=g.creditid
 and  g.cardid=2 and ac.cardid=2
 ) aa
order by boorowerid asc

datasets.name: ODS_zamin
datasets.sql:
select p.id,p.boorowerid,p.numberofcredit,(select name from filial where id =p.branchid ) filial,p.creditlineamount,
case when p.partitionkey=0 then  'Açıq'else 'Bağlı' end status,
g.guarantorname,to_date(g.dateofbirth)dateofbirth,g.pincode,g.cuntry,g.city,g.guarantorid,g.zmpaspyer1,to_date(g.zmpaspdat1) zmpaspdat1,g.zaminadres1,
g.factadres,g.zaminwork1,g.guarantorsalary, g.zmtelmob1, tmnus_status,tmnus_portfstatus
from cm_portfolio p,cm_guarantor g where p.id=g.creditid
order by p.boorowerid desc
